summary_md: **oil-oil ([@I_am_oil_oil](https://x.com/I_am_oil_oil/status/2116755896466600363))** built **oil-diff**, a skill that turns git changes into a visual HTML report understandable to a non-author, grouping edits by business logic with before/after diagrams and screenshots, a drawer for key file diffs, and bundled scripts and templates for stable output ([oil-oil/oil-diff](https://github.com/oil-oil/oil-diff)).
